inventoryScope.literalCallPolicy: Literal .from/.rpc calls on Supabase/client receivers, five statically resolved dynamic database RPC dispatches, and nine statically resolved dynamic Storage bucket calls.
limitations: Dynamic relation names other than the statically resolved Core/legacy RPC dispatches require manual review.
Static source inspection proves call construction, not Production execution.
Service-role access bypasses RLS; compatibility therefore depends on explicit server authorization and scope.

negativeFindings.finding: No live cron or scheduled database caller was identified in the repository scan.
blockers: External platform schedules cannot be excluded by repository absence.

negativeFindings.finding: No live background worker implementing the proposed Offline review, payment reconciliation, or effect ledger was identified.
No direct browser invocation of the customer creation RPC was identified; creation is routed through app/api/customers/route.ts.

blockers: Static evidence cannot prove Production ACL, RLS reachability, object ownership, or external callers.
Target profile route with exact seven fields is not implemented.
Inventory history route lacks the complete 30/366-day and created_at,id ordering contract.
Core V2 does not bind the complete offline device/employee generation authority.
